noAnvil.text: You have to be standing in front of an anvil lab to blacksmith something!

noHammer.text: You need to equip a blacksmith tool to repair this!

needChunk.text: You need a {} to repair this!

cantRepair.text: You don't know how to repair that.

noStove.text: You have to be standing in front of a stove or a campfire to cook something!

unskilled.text: You aren't skilled in cooking, you'd just burn it

cantCook.text: You don't know how to cook that.

burned.text: Your food is rea....wait a minute, you burned it! You need more practice!

noLab.text: You have to be standing in front of an alchemy lab to mix something!

noSand.text: You must be holding some alchemist sand in your hand to mix the potion!

mixBegin.text: You begin to mix the potion.

potionOff.text: Your potion seems a little off...maybe you should practice more.

noCarpentryBench.text: You have to be standing in front of a carpentry bench to build something!

noSaw.text: You need a carpentry tool equipped to build with!

unskilledBuild.text: You aren't skilled in carpentry, you'd just ruin the logs

buildFailed.text: You built a...a...you messed it all up!! You need more practice in carpentry

fizzle.text: The cauldron bubbles...but then fizzles out.

puff.text: The cauldron bubbles...and with a huge puff of smoke, a new item appears inside.

interrupted.text: You stop what you were making.
